subject.title: Automatizar despliegue de supply con EAS Build + Submit

question: Should https://github.com/Hamelyn-SL/hamelyn-serverless/pull/6544 become the canonical Supply EAS Build + Submit deploy path, including branch-pushed version bumps and production draft submits?
rationale: This is release automation with store-submit authority and GitHub/EAS secret handling, so a maintainer should approve the operational policy before the tracker can close.

options.title: Finish and review the linked PR

options.title: Narrow the workflow first

options.title: Pause the deploy automation
